tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (213)༄༅/ /shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor snang ba'i go 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ // /
(213)༄༅/ /shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor snang ba'i go 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (213)༄༅// shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor snang ba'i go 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(214)༄༅// na mo gu ru pañca tan+t+ra se na dz+nyā na na thā ye/ mthar thug ston pa rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang*// myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i byin brlab kyis// grub pa gnyis stsol 'di phyi'i bar chad sol// zab gsang bstan pa rgyas pa'i dge legs stsol// rje btsun chen po tā ra nā tha'i mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil la kho bos gsal byed zhabs 'degs zhus pa la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ thog mar sgrub dkyil de nyid las zhib par brtags te bsham bkod/ 'don 'grigs/ lag len sogs shin tu nges par bya ba de las gsal bar smos ma dgos/ sgrub gnas rnying pa dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor skabs sa chog mi dgos/ thog mar brgyud 'debs rnams dang*/ sngon 'gro phyogs skyong dang*/ gnas bdag yul bdag gtor ma btang*/ gnas khang mchod rdzas byin brlab/ sgrub thabs ltar skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed/ bzlas pa nyer bsdu/ thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba'i bar rdzogs par btang*/ de nas sta gon la 'jug pas cho ga kyang*/ srung ba'i don du spyi dang mthun par phur gdab spro na sa bzung ba'i skabs su 'byung bar ltar/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang sogs nas bgegs gtor btang*/ /(215)hūm̐ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sogs kyi bka' bsgos la/ phur gdab rdzogs par bya/ de nas sa'i lha mo lhag gnas/ lha lhag gnas/ bum pa lhag gnas bcas grub nas slob ma lhag gnas bya ste/ slob ma rnams sgo drung du 'dus te las bum chus khrus bya/ gral du 'khod pa la me tog bkram bsdu byas la sta gon gyi chos bcu bdun las/ dang po thun mong gi bslab bya bshad pa ni/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyi don du sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed kyi dbang bskur pa zhus te grol byed rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo mthar phyin pa bgyi'o snyam du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/

chos gsan pa'i kun spyod dang kun slong rnam par dag pa mdo rgyud rnams las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin legs par gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de yang 'o skol rnams dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che rnyed par dka' ba thob kyang 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag (216)pa'i rang bzhin yin pas 'chi ba nam 'ong cha med/ shi ba'i 'og tu rnam shes las kyi rjes su 'brang bas dge sdig gi blang dor ma nor ba la 'bad rtsol bya dgos/ 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das shing thog ma med pa nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ slar yang mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong dgos la nges 'byung gi blo shugs drag por bskyed nas thar pa'i lam la 'jug dgos/ thar pa'i lam bzang po ni phyi rol mu stegs pa sogs grub mtha' ngan pa gzhan la med/ nang pa sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba rtsa bar bzung nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la 'jug dgos/ de'ang bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje dang bka' drin tshad ma mchis pa mnyam med shākya'i dbang po 'di nyid kyis thog mar 'dren pa gzhan gyis spangs pa'i rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams la dgongs nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'ang sangs rgyas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par mdzad/ bar du bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du tshogs bsags bsam gyis mi khyab pas sa bcu dang lam lnga mthar phyin nas rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su ma ga dha rdo rje gdan du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan te chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab par bskor ba rnams la nyan thos kyi lugs su chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong du grags/ de dag kyang gdul bya'i dbang po dman 'bring*/ mchog gi dbang du byas nas sde snod gsum du bsdu/

de'ang theg pa che chung gnyis su dbye ba las theg dman las khyad par du mas 'phags (217)pa theg pa chen po byang chub sems kyi theg pas khyad par du byas pa yin/ de la'ang rgyu lam du byas pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam du byas pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis su dbye ba las/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni sangs rgyas 'di nyid kyi thugs bskyed kyi stobs kyis bstan pa 'di kho na la byon pa las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang ma gsungs/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsungs par mi 'gyur bas u dum wā ra ltar dkon cing grol ba bzhi dang ldan pas gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa ni shin tu skal pa bzang po dang ldan pa yin/ gsang sngags nyid sde snod gsum po spyi khyab yin par bzhed pa dang*/ khyad par can du byas pa sogs mchis kyang dpung bzang gis zhus pa las// lha dang lha min mi la phan gdags phyir// gsang sngags rigs sngags rnam par sna tshogs dang*// bye ba phrag gsum dang ni 'bum phrag lnga// rig 'dzin sde snod bshad par rgyal bas gsungs/ zhes dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas// sangs rgyas mchog gis chos gsungs pa// mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa dang*// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde bzhir gnas// zhes gsungs shing slob dpon gzhan gyis kyang de ltar bstan pa mang bas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces khyad par du 'phags pa'i sde snod bzhi par bzhag pa la nang gses kyi dbye ba gnyis nas bdun gyi bar du bzhag pa sogs rnam grangs mang yang sbyong gzhi dus bzhi/ mi rigs bzhi/ 'dod chags bzhi/ dbang po bzhi sogs bzhi tshan rnams la dgongs nas rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba ni grags che ste/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ (218)bya min rnal 'byor de lta ga la'o// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor rgyud// rnal 'byor bla med de lta ga la'o// zhes sogs rgyud sde gzhan la'ang rgya cher 'byung ba ltar bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med kyi rim par bzhugs pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la thabs gtso bor ston pa pha'i rgyud dang shes rab gtso bor ston pa ma'i rgyud gnyis su dbye ba las 'dir skabs su bab pa rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di ni mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor de nyid dgung grangs lnga bcu par rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du phebs te rdo rje 'chang dngos kyis rjes su bzung ba'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa gnyis dang mkhas grub brgya dang lnga bcu'i zhabs pad bsten te rig pa'i gnas dang mdo rgyud man ngag kun la mkhas par sbyangs pas bshad pa dang rtsod pa dang sgrub pa'i lam rim gyi bka' babs/

grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ khyad par gtum mo ston pa'i mthar thug /dgyes rdor mtshon cha dang thod pa can lha dgu'i bskor ba grub chen ḍom+bi pa dang mtsho skyes zhabs kyi lugs/ las rgya ston pa'i mthar thug bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa lū hi pa'i lugs/ sgyu ma rmi lam ston pa'i mthar thug ma hā ma ya lha lnga pa ku ku ri pa'i lugs/ 'od gsal ston pa'i mthar thug gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gsum pa 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs/ mngon spyod ston pa'i mthar thug rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po lha bcu gsum pa la li ta badz+ra'i lugs rnams brgyud pa so so las gsan mod kyi 'dir de rnams gcig tu dril ba'i blos btags kyis dkyil 'khor gcig tu mdzad pa ma yin te/ bcom ldan (219)'das thub pa'i dbang pos dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud gsung pa'i skabs bde dgyes sogs kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud sde thams cad slar yang bstan pa dang*/ rgyud sde gzhan yang mang du gsungs pa'i nang mtshan rin chen rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i rgyud sde chen po las rgyud sde lnga po 'di dkyil 'khor gcig tu sgrub pa'i tshul gsal bar bstan pa'i rgyud de nyid khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje snying po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ lha lcam dpal mo// sa man+ta badz+ra dza ya de ba las rdo rje ga na pa bar pa/ puṇ+ya ka ras gsan pa ni ring brgyud dang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ blo gros rin chen/ sha ba ri pa/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ dha byang chub sems dpa' las rdo rje gdan pa bar pas gsan pa ni nye rgyud dang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ grub pa'i dpa' bo/ rat+na ka ra/ ār+ya badz+ra/ grub chen rā hu las gsan pa ni shin tu nye brgyud de/ mkhas grub de gnyis las khyung po rnal 'byor gyis smin grol rdzogs par gsan/ rgyud chen 'di 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub gzhan la ma grags shing bod du'ang ma 'gyur/

'di rigs gzhan du'ang mang bar yod par snang bas bod du 'gyur ba'i gsung rab nyung shas la brten nas mdo rgyud kyi rigs dag ma dag gi kha tshon bcad pa ni nam mkha' 'doms 'jal ba'i dper snang ngo*// mkhas grub khyung pos rmog lcog pa la gnang ste da bon ston skyer sgang pa sogs nas rim par brgyud da lta'i bar du brgyud pa zam ma chad par byon pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i dbang bskur ba bsgrub par bgyi ba la slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang dbang bskur dngos gzhi (220)gnyis su yod pa las de ring gi skabs su sta gon gyi chos rnams sgrub par bgyi ba yin// de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du grub/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa lhag gnas kyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /de nas dkyil chog ltar/ sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya/ sogs nas/ de rnams kyi bsam pa rnam dag bskyed dgos so/ /zhes gdams/ gnyis pa spro bar bskyed pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ sogs nas/ 'di 'bras 'grub/ ces gsungs te/ sngags kyi dngos grub rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes don du gnyer ba dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya'i/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang dang*/ rang don du nyan rang gi byang chub 'dod pa rnams ni ma yin te/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la ma ltos par thabs dman pa gzhan la brten nas bsgrub tu yod pa'i phyir ro// de bas na bdag gzhan thams cad srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba'i dad pa can blo gros dang ldan pa dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya ste/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras don du gnyer bas zhugs na pha rol gyi don mi 'grub cing*/ gzhan don du mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas la dmigs te zhugs na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don bde blag tu 'grub par yin/

zhes gsungs pas don thugs la nges par zhu/ gsum pa gsol ba btab pa ni/ snyims pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston (221)pa ste/ sogs gsum/ /bzhi pa spro ba bskyed pa ni/ khyed rnams khyad par can gyi lam zab mo rdo rje theg pa la don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa de shin tu legs pa yin no// zhes shes pa'i ched du spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ bu tshur theg pa nas/ blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces dang*/ lnga pa rtog pa bsdu ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad/ nas/ byin mi rlobs/ ces gsungs pas dbang gi tshig rna ba gtad de mi nyan pa dang*/ don ji bzhin tu 'dzin par mi byed pa rnams snod min spang byar gsungs shing de lta bu la dbang rdzogs par bskur yang dbang don gyi ye shes ji bzhin skye bar mi 'gyur bas rtse gcig tu dad pas nyan cing nan tan du 'dzin par dgos so/ /drug pa sdom gsum bstan pa ni/ dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid slob dpon gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ so sor thar pa'i 'dul ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin tu srung zhing gzhan la phan par bgyid do snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan dkyil 'khor des gsungs chos/ sogs nas/ ston par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum/ bdun pa yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor la dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs sprin gtibs pa lta bus bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar (222)bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags shing*/

'khor 'das kun gyi dge ba la yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ dge rtsa byang chub chen por bsngo zhing lus 'bul ba bcas yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ sogs sgrub thabs dbu nas 'byung ba ltar la/ khyod kyi sku gsum 'grub par shog /bar lan gsum/ brgyad pa dris lan ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sogs nas khyod 'dod dam/ zhes dris pa'i lan btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas/ bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lan btab/ dgu pa sdom pa bsgrags pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa la rag las pas shin tu gal che bas srung sdom bya dgos pa ni 'di dag yin no zhes bsgrags pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ sogs nas/ yang dag bshad/ bar lan gsum/ bcu pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ ji skad gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams legs par blangs nas tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ slob dpon 'dir ni sogs dang*/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ bcu gcig pa gnas gsum byin rlabs ni/ slob ma skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar zla ba la oṃ las 'khor lo (223)oṃ gyis mtshan pa las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mgrin pa sna tshogs pad+ma la ā las pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ las rdo rjer hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las thugs rdo rje sku mdog mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rnams su gyur/

slob ma'i gnas gsum du bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang sbyar ba'i thig le bya/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par gyur/ nyer spyod lnga/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/

de ltar byas pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa de cho ga 'dis ngo 'phrod cing de gsal bar byas pa yin/ de ltar sems bskyed cing sgo gsum lhar byas ma thag pa de mchod yul du bzung ba yin/ me tog dbu la phul nas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ bdug spos shangs la= dhu pe= mar me spyan lam du= ā lo ke= dri'i byugs pa thugs kar= gan+dhe= zhal zas ljags la= nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa ni lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don yin no// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par// mchod pa kun dang ldan pa yi// dus kun tu ni dge bar mnos/ zhes brjod/ khyed rang rnams kyis rang gi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje gsum la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos (224)mdzod/ oṃ sku yi rdo rje sku yi mchog /ye shes dang ldan gti mug sel// bcom ldan gtso bo sku rdo rje// sku yi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab pas// sku rdo rje slob ma'i lus la thim pas// lus sku rdo rje'i ngo bor mos la// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal 'dzin du gzhug /de bzhin du/ gsung gi rdo rje gsung gi mchog /so sor rtog pas 'dod chags 'joms// bcom ldan gtso bo gsung rdo rje// gsung gi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab/ gsung rdo rje slob ma'i ngag la thim pas/ ngag gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ /de bzhin du/ thugs kyi rdo rje thugs dam bskul// dag pa'i rang bzhin zhe sdang sbyong*// bcom ldan gtso bo thugs rdo rje/ thugs kyi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs rdo rje slob ma'i yid la thim pas/

yid thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra= sogs ko3haṃ/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor cing brtan par yang bya'o// bcu gnyis pa so shing dor ba ni/ ba byung gis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal thig bzhis ling tshe dgur bgos pa zhig byas la/ byang chub kyi shing du mos pa'i so shing ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes brjod pas slob ma'i lag tu gtad la 'cha' ba'i tshul bgyis pas sdig sgrib thams cad skyugs par bsam la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas te so shing gi rwa bar dor zhig /oṃ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes 'dor du gzhug /de ltar dor bas ltas kyi mtshan ma bshad pa ni/ spyi rgyud las/ de tshe bdag la lta ba dang*// rtse mo gyen du 'greng gyur (225)na/ de ni dngos grub mchog ces bya/ de bzhin shar du kha bltas na// de ni dngos grub 'bring du bshad// mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na// 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub 'grub// so shing dor ba brgya lam zhig /gal te thur du kha bltas na// de ni nges par sa 'og gi/ dngos grub de ni the tshom med// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// des ni gnas skabs su sdig sgrib 'dag cing dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas shes pa dang mthar thug 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe byang chub kyi shing rtsol med du 'byung ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /bcu gsum pa srung skud gdags pa ni/ srung skud kha dog lnga ldan khru gang bar mdud pa gsum btab la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung skud mdud pa gsum la oṃ āḥhūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha gsum/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi srad bu rdo rje gsum dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha gsum zhu ba las mdud pa'i rnam par gyur/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su bcings/

'di'i gnas skabs kyi dgos pa khams byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba'i bar chad mtha' dag bsrung ba dang*/ mthar thug gi dgos pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas nas bdud kyis mi tshugs pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ bcu bzhi pa khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i chu 'di nyid phyag g.yas g.yon gang rung gi khyor ba bzed de zhal du bzhes te 'pho bas ngag gi nyes sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pa'i mthar/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha dharmā sarba pā paṃ nish+tsa a s+ya sho dha ya (226)sarba bi kalpā na yā pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyi khyor chu sbyin/ des ni gnas skabs kyi dgos pa kha dag pa/ ngag sgrib sbyong ba/ rmi lam gsal bor 'byung ba gsum dang*/ mthar thug gi dgos pa rang nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe na sku gsung thugs kyi dag pa gsum 'thob pa'o/ /bco lnga pa ku sha sbyin pa ni/ dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika hūm̐ zhes/ lag pa g.yas su byin te sngas kyi don dang*/ hā las byung ba'i ku sha oṃ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes/ lag pa g.yas su sbyin te stan gyi don du zungs shig /'di'i gnas skabs kyi dgos pa ku sha 'di dag byed kyi rtswa gtsang zhing dge ba yin pas rmi lam mi 'khrul ba dang bar chad thams cad srung*/ ma 'ongs par rang nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe ku sha'i gdan rtsol med du 'byung ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ bcu drug pa chos bshad pa ni/ de ni phyir mi ldog pa zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni rgyud las gsungs pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'jig rten du ni sogs brjod la mthar/ zhes gsungs pa'i don thugs la nges pas gsang sngags kyi theg pa rnyed dka' zhing rnyed na phan yon chen po dang ldan pa dang*/ de ltar rnyed pa la spro ba rgya chen po bskyed mdzod/ bcu bdun pa gzing bstod pa ni/ nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur bas dga' ba rgya chen po gyis la/

ku sha'i gdan la seng ge'i nyal stabs dang*/ dge ba'i sems kyis nyol shig /rmi lam ci mthong ba de yang nangs par nga la legs par smros shig /ces brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa lhag gnas mjug gi bya ba ni/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs pa'i sngags rgya sogs dang mchod bstod gsol gdab bcas (227) dkyil 'khor ltar bya'o// de nas tshom bu sogs bsdus la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ dkyil 'khor lnga po'i dbus su mañja'i steng du sngar sta gon byas pa'i bum pa lnga po phyogs ma nor ba dgod/ gtso bum khar dung chu gzungs rdor bcas dang*/ las bum byang du bzhag /dbang chas gzhan gang bder bzhag chog kyang kar lugs phyag bzhes ltar na dkyil 'khor gyi lhor dbu rgyan/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du dril bu// mdun du rdor dril lhan cig bcings pa rnams dang*/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la ḍār dril btags pa/ gri gug thod pa dngos sam tsakli/ gsang dbang thod chang*/ rig tsaka rnams kyang ci bder bzhag /rgyab phyogs su 'bul gtor lnga tshom/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul bcas bkod/ gzhung gsal phyogs mtshams brgyad du rgyal mtshan brgyad dang mchod pa'i bum pa brgyad kyang de mnyam bkram/ mchod pa lha sta gon skabs bshad pa ltar dgos pas chu bzhi'i snod dung zhal sogs bzhi mdun ngos su bzhag /me tog spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas bcas nyer spyod lnga tshar sum cu so bdun gyis dkyil 'khor mtha' bskor/ rjes gnang chas/ mig thur/ me long*/ dril bu/ mda' gzhu/ 'khor lo// dung*/ pusti rnams kyang snod gcig tu logs gang bder bzhag /gzhan yang sngon 'gro gtor ma/ phyi rol gtor ma/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du nang mchod bdud rtsi bshams/ sgrub dkyil la dgos pa'i yo byad gzhan rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o// de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon tu 'gro bas/ dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin sbyong ba/

khrus gsol/ bgegs bskrad pa rnams bya/ mchod pa byin brlab/ sgrub thabs ltar skyabs 'gro nas brtsams bdag bskyed bsdu ldang gi bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ dkyil chog ltar dkyil 'khor bskyed/ gzengs bstod/ sgrub pa lnga nas brtsams te bzlas pa mchod bstod kyi bar rgyas par btang*/ 'das gtor sgrub thabs ltar 'bul/ myur mdzad mgon po/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma rnams nang gtor (228) du 'bul/ phyi rol tu phyin la phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i gtor ma btang*/ nang du phyin la bskor ba dang gsol gdab byas la bdag 'jug rdzogs par blang*/ dkyil 'khor yol bas sgrib bo// gnyis pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma rnams sgo drung du 'dus la las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ phyag bcas gral du 'khod la me tog bkram bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ de la skabs su bab pa rgyud lung man ngag yid ches kyi tshad ma dang ldan cing*/ grub thob brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i snyan nas snyan du byon pa'i bcom ldan 'das rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byed pa la/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ phyi nang gi gtor chog btang ba/ bdag nyid 'jug pa rnams sngon du grub nas slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis yod pa la/ thog mar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bcom ldan 'das rgyud sde chen po lnga'i lha tshogs tha mi dad pa'i drung du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /de nas khyed rang rnams kyi phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzad par zhu/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste//

sogs sta gon skabs ltar lan gsum/ slar yang khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs lan gcig /khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgo phyes te nang du zhugs nas (229)shar gyi lha rnams la gnas par mos la/ thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas te phyag mdzod cig /oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhabs la btud pa'i phyag byas pas shin tu mnyes par mos mdzod/ sgo de nyid nas thon te g.yas bskor gyis lho'i sgo phyes te sogs gong gis 'gres te/ lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang rnams nas phyag byas te/ g.yas bskor gyis phyin te lha snam la 'khod par mos la/ sta gon skabs ltar mtshams sbyor bcas bdun rnam dag bya/ zab mo'i dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa la rigs dang skal ba shes dgos pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod gang la dga'/ zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ skal pa bzang la bdag dga'o/ /zhes dang*/ skal bzang des khyod ci zhig bya/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog 'dod dam tshig yin/ zhes lan btab/ gdong g.yog sbyin pa ni/ sngon chad rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong bas bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po kha tshar ma nyams res gdong g.yogs bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsak+ṣur+bhan+dha wa ra ma ṇa ye hūm̐/ zhes gdong g.yogs dmar po sbyin/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas phyag rten mtshon byed du u dum+ba ra sogs mchog gi me tog sna lnga'i phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bcug nas snying gar thogs par mos shig

/oṃ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ (230) zhes me tog gtad/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed pa'i slad du sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang thams cad rnal 'byor dang bde ba chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas thal mo sbyar ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ slob dpon gyis me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje slob ma'i snying gar bzhag la/ sems bskyed pa de brtan par bya ba'i mos par mdzod/ su ra te/ nas/ ya thā su khaṃ/ slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te mdun du zhugs par mos shig /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod la yol ba bsal/ de nas ye shes pa dbab pa'i sngon 'gro dam bzhag bzhi rim par bya ba yin te/ thog mar lha'i dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ sogs brjod/ de nas nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam bzhag pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal sogs brjod/ phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag cing*/ dam tshig rdo rje'i chu sbyin pa ni/ dung chu sbyin la/ /'di ni khyod kyi sogs brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng nas bzung ste sogs brjod/ de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor phyi'i 'jug pa rnams so// nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje rtse gcig (231) pa'i phyag rgya slob ma'i snying gar gtad la/ 'di ni ye shes rdo rje sogs brjod/ de nas lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sogs lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams lus kyi gnad drang por bsrang*/ ngag gnad srog rtsol kha sbyar du 'ching*/ sems kyi gnad gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di rtse gcig tu sgoms shig /khyed rnams 'od dpag med dmar po sogs dmigs pa spros/ byin 'bebs kyi spos sbyor bdug rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas la byin 'bebs sngags lan mang du brjod/ de nas bden stobs brjod pa ni/ rdor dril bcas/ a khaṃ/ yang dag pa yi sogs brjod/ de nas sngar nas 'brel ba'i lha'i rigs brtags pa'i slad du me tog 'bul ba ni/ sngar byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba las ma nyams pa'i me tog gcig gi phreng bar mos te dkyil 'khor dbus la 'dor bar mos te sngar nas las kyi 'brel ba'i rigs kyi lha gang yin pa la phog par shog cig snyam du ltos pa med par tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du dor ba dang lhan cig 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sngon nas sgrub pa'i sogs brjod du gzhug /khyod rang me tog dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phog pas gtso bo'i rigs yin no// zhes pa lta bu phyogs dang rigs me tog gang la phog par bsgyur/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi

sogs brjod la me tog slar spyi bor bcing*/ mig dbye ba ni/ slob ma'i mig tu oṃ yig re re gsal/ ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yog ji mchis pa thams cad mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ he ru ka dpal sogs brjod la/ rdo rjes mig dar dbye/ de ltar ma (232)rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs bsal nas ye shes dag pa'i mig thob pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum du mthong bar mos shig /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ sogs brjod/ de nas lha ngo bo rgyas par bstan dgos pas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba sogs sgrub thabs kyi mngon rtogs ltar la/ e las dang yaṃ las sogs sa bon rnams bor te/ ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa rtsigs pa'i phyi rol 'gram stegs zhes pa nas/ de rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal med khang dbus gtsang phyur bu dang bcas pa lnga tshoms su gnas pa/ rta babs dang bral ba rnams so// de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas/ 'od kyi khyab par mdzad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gtso bo mtshon cha can bsgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du gau rī nag mo nas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o// nang gi gzhal yas khang dbus ma'i lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte ba la nas/ gar gyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// gzhal yas khang shar ma'i nang le'u tshe dgu pa nas/ gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'o// gzhal yas khang lho ma'i nang gi lha

snam nas/ (233)gri gug thod pa bsnams pa'o'i bar/ gzhal yas khang nub ma'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po nas/ gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'o// gzhal yas khang byang ma'i dbus kyi lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje nas/ gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o// phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi shar sgor rta gdong ma nas/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgo skyong ma bzhi char yang spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra dmar nas nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha' la sogs brjod/ de dag gis dkyil 'khor du phyi nang gi 'jug pa'i rim pa rnams so/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ dbang bzhi pa rnams rim bzhin 'byung ba'i dang po bum dbang la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis su yod pa las/ thog mar rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ zhes dbul du gzhug /gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ he ru ka dpal= sogs lan gsum/ dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba bgegs sbyong ba'i slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo dang mtshon cha me dpung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad cing bsgo ba mi nyan pa thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mos shig /oṃ sum+bha ni sogs drag tu brjod cing yungs thun/ gu gul dud pa/ rol mo drag tu bya'o// de nas mdun tu til dang me chu bshams/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying (234)gar yi ge baṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis ded ste/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim par mos/ zhes brjod la sna bug g.yas nas til la rlung 'bud du gzhug

/bsang sbyangs/ 'bar ba'i me'i nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru swā hā/ lan gsum brjod la/ til g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ /g.yas su me dang g.yon du chur dor bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang*/ rgya mtsho chen por skyur bar bsam/ mthar me yang chu nang du blugs so/ de nas dbang dngos la dang po rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba la thog mar mi bskyod pa chu dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal buṃ chu sogs brjod pa'i skabs las rdor gyis bum pa bzhi po'i bum chu gtso bum du bsdu/ de nyid thogs la/ slob dpon gyis khrus sngon du 'gro bas bum dbang bskur/ brtan byed chu dbang*/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas khyed rang rnams la thim pa la nyer spyod lngas mchod cing bstod pa byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ las rdor gyi slob ma mchod pa btegs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wī d+yā ā hūm̐ bar dang rol mo'am dril bu dkrol/ mi bskyod pa ni sogs shwa lo ka gcig gis bstod/ de ltar khyod la chu'i dbang bskur bas sogs nas/ mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /ces pa'i bar dag pa brjod/ de nas rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyangs/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan sogs nas dag par brjod pa'i bar gzhung ltar bya/ 'di phyin chad la des 'gres te/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin (235)mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas dag par brjod pa yan sngar ltar bya/ de nas don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ /bsang sbyang*/

slob ma dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas dag par gyur pa'i bar sngar ltar bya/ de nas rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas/ sogs nas dag pa brjod pa'i bar dang*/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs brjod/ gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ zhes 'bul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i sogs lan gsum/ thog mar brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su sogs nas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga sogs gtad pa'i bar/ de nas rdor dril dang dam tshig gsum sbyin pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdor dril bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas shis brjod/ chu dbang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan pa'i bar gzhung ltar brjod/ de nas rjes gnang rnams rim par sbyin pa la thog mar sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis so so'i phyag rgya byas la/ sgeg dang bcas pa'o phreng ba 'phang*/ sogs rdzogs par brjod/ mig thur gyis rjes gnang ni/ praṃ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi thur ma'i khyed rang rnams kyi de bzhin nyid mthong ba la bsgrib pa'i ma rig pa'i ling thog gsal bar mos shig /mig thur gyis dbye tshul byas la/ ji ltar mig (236)mkhan rgyal po sogs brjod/ me long gi rjes gnang ni/ chos can gyi snang ba thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar nges pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig /ces shes pa'i slad du āḥlas skyes pa'i me long*// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ sogs brjod la me long bstan/ dril bu'i rjes gnang ni/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu 'di'i sgras mtshon te chos thams cad grags stong skye ba med pa'i mtshan nyid du rtogs par gyis shig

/thams cad nam mkha'i sogs brjod la dril bu dkrol/ mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang ni/ rang don yid byed kyi blo spangs pa'i slad du hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu/ thabs kyi mda' drug shes rab kyi gzhu la bkang ste phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og tu 'phang pas bdud bzhi dang nyan rang gi sems yid la byed pa bcom pa yin snyam du mos shig /de bzhin gshegs pa sogs brjod la mda' gzhu gtad cing 'phang ba'i tshul byar gzhugs/ de nas chos pa bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ rkang 'og gnyis su 'khor lo byin par mos shig /oṃ badz+ra hi tu mi sogs brjod la 'khor lo rkang 'og tu gzhug /chos kyi dung chen 'bud par gyis shig ces pa'i don/ oṃ badz+ra bhā kha raṃ sogs brjod la lag g.yas su dung gtad/ rgyud lung man ngag 'di'i sgo nas chos shod la sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i brda la rgyud kyi glegs bam gtad pa'i mos pa gyis/ oṃ ma hā dharma sogs brjod la glegs bam gtad/ tshul ji lta bus chos 'chad na skabs so sor babs pa'i rigs lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phrin las rnams sgrub cig zhes pa'i don tu rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ 'khor lo sogs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rim par gtad la/ 'jig rten khams ni sogs brjod/ sems can gyi don gang la gang 'tshams kyi (237)bya ba'i slad du phrin las bzhi dang grub pa brgyad kyi rjes su gnang bar mos shig /mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ zhi dang rgyas dang sogs brjod/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal gyis 'dod yon lnga tshogs su rol pa'i rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas sogs brjod/ snang stong dbyer med kyi lha sgoms pa'i rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/ 'dir 'dzoms na rgyud sde gtso bo'am tsakli sogs bstan/ ma 'dzoms kyang chog /'dod chags bral ba sogs brjod/ gsung gsang sngags kyi rjes gnang stsal bar mos shig

/me tog 'thor la/ rigs lnga 'di la sogs lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog 'bul bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ rigs lnga bdag la sogs lan gsum/ slar me tog 'thor la/ sngags kyi dngos grub sogs brjod/ de ltar dbang gis rgyud smin pa'i slob ma rnams byang chub mchog tu lung bstan pa yin te/ slob dpon gyis snam sbyar mnab/ grwa gnyis ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas te phyag g.yon pas thugs kar bzung g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i rgyas rdor dril bzung la/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das sogs brjod/ snam sbyar phud la skyabs sbyin gyis rgyas/ khyed rang rnams deng nas bzung te srid pa'i ngan 'gro las rtag tu bton par dbugs dbyung bar mos shig /gsang chen mchog gi sogs brjod/ de nas brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang byin par mos shig /dbang rdzas rdo rje bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs gzhung ltar brjod la gtad/ /de nas rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyi dag pa brjod pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ sems can don phyir sems bskyed pas sogs dang*/ de ltar na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs sogs bum dbang gi dag pa'ang brjod/ de nas dbang gong ma gsum (238)zhu ba'i yon thun mong du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul/ thun mong du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag ni 'khor ba bying ba sogs lan gsum/ slob dpon bcom ldan sogs nas/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ sogs mkha' gsang byin brlabs sgrub thabs ltar la/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mos sogs nas/ āt+ma ko3 haṃ bar brjod/ gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bar/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs 'ching mdzod/

ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ badz+ra yo ga sogs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i mkha' gsang nas byon pa'i dkar dmar byang chub sems kyi rgyun khyed rang rnams la byin pa mos shig /bdud rtsi sbyin la/ ji ltar bcom ldan sogs sngags bcas brjod/ khyed rnams kyis sngags 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas bdud rtsi myong zhig /a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ de bzhin tu shes rab rdo rje sogs kyis bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad bcas lan gcig bskur te sbyin/ byang sems dkar mar gyis lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad la rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtogs pa dbyings su thim/ gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ dar gcig bzhag /lus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yog sol mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi sogs rtog pa (239) brjod/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs lan gsum/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs 'ching mdzod/ sngags bcas mig dar bcing*/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sogs nas/ dngos grub med/ bar brjod la rig tsaka gtad/ de ltar byon pa'i lha mo des kyang 'di skad dris pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bdud rtsi bza' dang sogs nas bde byed smros/ bar brjod/ spro bas lan 'debs par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ lha mo ci phyir nas/ 'o byed bar brjod/ lha mo dgyes nas 'di skad gsungs te pang du byon par mos shig /a ho nga yi sogs brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can sogs dang*/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs gong ltar bya/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i

sogs nas/ brtan par gyur par mos la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yog sol mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdong g.yog bkrol/ de ltar bha ga'i dkyil 'khor sogs rtog pa brjod/ bzhi pa chen po tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ khyed zhabs pad+mo'i sogs lan gsum/ rdo rje'i tshig 'di'i don rjes su dran pas gang du'ang rnam par rtog pa'i ye shes chen po'i dbyings su bltar med pa'i tshul gyis ltos la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ ye shes 'di ni sogs nas/ skad cig de la sgom/ bar brjod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig bsgrags pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems (240)kyi sogs rtog pa brjod/ de dag rnams kyis rin chen rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi dgongs don slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor las brgyud pa'i rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba legs par grub pa yin pas de dag gi skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag tshul bzhin tu srung ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bo'i ji ltar

sogs gsum/ dbang bskur rdzogs par thob pa'i btang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi 'byor ba ltar sprul te 'bul na cha shas nas bzhes te longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum/ rnam dkar gyi dge rtsa mtha' dag 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa dang 'di nyid kyi sgo nas kyang rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen por bsgrub par mdzod cig /bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon shis brjod gang 'os bya'o// de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ tshogs mchog 'dod na bde mchog lha lnga ltar bya/ gzhung du ma bshad pas ma grub kyang chog /dkyil chog gi gsham nas 'byung ba ltar mchod pa rnams kha gsos byin brlab/ mchod bstod bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i sogs brjod la dngos grub zhu/ yig brgya lan nyer gcig bzla/ bzod gsol bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris skabs/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs spyi ltar brjod la ye shes pa rnams rten dang dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ zhes mos/ sngar phur gdab byas na/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni (241)sarba ār+tha sa dha ni swā hā/ zhes spyan ma'i sngags kyi phur bu rnams dbyung*/ sngags de nyid kyis phur khung dgang*/ skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu/ sogs thun mong ma yin bsngo smon rgyas pa dang shis brjod byas rol mo snyan par dkrol bzhin me tog gi char dbab so// mi bskyod rdo rje bzhi yi ye shes ni/ mi zad rgyan 'khor lnga yi dkyil 'khor du/ shar ba'i dbyangs dang mnyam par nyid gyur nas/ srid 'gro de yis phyag rgyas thebs par shog /'di'ang rje btsun rin po che nas mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi zhabs 'degs dang*/

snga phyir bskul pa po mang zhig gi slad du karma bka' brgyud kyi bral mtha' 'khod pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rang lo gya bdun par dpal spungs yang khrod shrī de bi ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gis sgrub gnas su bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni gam du 'khod pa blo gsal gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /(342)
